reasons: Quantity differs: Datadog sum:redis.keys counts keys, but redis.db.avg_ttl is the average TTL of keys in a db (gauge, ms), a different measure.
Unit differs: keys count versus milliseconds; no scale can bridge them.

Template variable $host (prefix host, default *) should become host=~"$host" but is dropped; $key (prefix key, default *) should become key=~"$key" but is missing entirely, so the series set is wrong.

Candidate should not be translated with redis.db.avg_ttl; the converter should look for an OTel key-count metric (e.g. a redis.db.keys-style sum) and translate against it, or block with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING if none exists.
